exposure: Linear Cutter Vessel Sealing System (LCVSS) technique for cesarean hysterectomy
No specific surgical technique for cesarean hysterectomy
outcome: Total perioperative blood transfusion of ≥4 units of packed red blood cells (PRBCs)
Total perioperative blood transfusion of ≥6 units of PRBCs
cohort: Patients undergoing cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta spectrum
finding: The use of the LCVSS technique for cesarean hysterectomy in patients with placenta accreta spectrum resulted in significantly lower cumulative blood loss and blood transfusion rates compared to no specific surgical technique.
